info.title: FDA Recalls API
info.description: JSON REST API for the US Food and Drug Administration's official recall feed: food, drug, device, and product recalls, market withdrawals, and safety alerts, filterable by keyword. Available on RapidAPI: https://rapidapi.com/crisp-point-studio-crisp-point-studio-default/api/live-fda-product-food-recalls

get.description: Returns the most recent FDA recall notices, newest first. The FDA feed carries the 20 most recent notices, so unfiltered requests return up to 20 entries. Pass `search` to keep only titles containing a keyword.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive keyword match on the recall title, e.g. salmonella, listeria, or a brand name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

200.description: Array of recall notices, newest first.

example.title: Oliva LLC Issues Allergy Alert on Undeclared Sesame in Baba Ghanouj, Spicy Baba Ghanouj, and Hummus

422.description: Invalid query parameter, e.g. limit outside 1–250.

429.description: Plan quota or rate limit exceeded.

title.description: Recall headline as published by the FDA.

link.description: URL of the full notice on fda.gov.

pubDate.description: Publication time, RFC 2822 format, US Eastern time.
